executable.title: Tubules Sub-Compartments Refinement (ROI nuclei subtraction)
executable.description: Refines an existing tubules_subcompartments annotation by subtracting nuclei (from a nuclei annotation or GeoJSON-style nuclei) within each tubule ROI, producing a new refined tubules_subcompartments annotation back onto the slide (polyline elements in slide coordinates). Downloads the WSI + required annotations via Girder, runs refinement, then POSTs the result as a new annotation and uploads the JSON to the item.
executable.acknowledgements: This work is part of efforts in digital pathology by the Sarder Lab: UFL.

image.name: svsFile
image.label: Input SVS / Item
image.description: Girder file _id or item _id for the whole-slide image. If an item id is provided, the largest WSI-like file is chosen.

parameters.label: Refinement Controls
parameters.description: ROI processing and polygon cleanup parameters

integer.name: minLumenAreaPx
integer.label: Minimum Lumen Component Area (px)
integer.description: Removes tiny lumen connected components smaller than this area (in ROI pixels).

parameters.label: Girder (Required for Orchestrator)
parameters.description: Used to download WSI + annotations, and POST the refined result.

string.name: girderToken
string.label: Girder API Token
string.description: Token for an authenticated user session
